note: Indication and warnings fields are empty headers only.
Labels cover PAH (WHO Group I) in adults and children 1-17 years; neonatal pulmonary hypertension is not mentioned.

quote: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) including chronic bronchitis and/or emphysema
note: Chronic bronchitis is explicitly named within the COPD indication.

quote: indicated for the palliative treatment of chronic myelogenous (myeloid, myelocytic, granulocytic) leukemia
note: CML is named directly as the indication.

quote: For symptomatic relief of anxiety and tension associated with psychoneurosis
note: The label treats the anxiety and tension symptoms, while the edge names the underlying psychoneurosis.
Ondansetron is indicated for CINV and PONV; vomiting of pregnancy is not mentioned.

quote: in adult patients with primary hypercholesterolaemia who are not adequately controlled with a statin alone
note: The EMA indication names primary hypercholesterolaemia.

quote: indicated for the treatment of recurrent herpes labialis (cold sores) in adults and children 12 years of age or older
note: Recurrent herpes labialis is recurrent oral herpes.

quote: or ≥27 kg/m2 to <30 kg/m2 (overweight) in the presence of at least one weight-related comorbidity
note: The EMA Wegovy indication covers weight management in adults with overweight.

quote: As replacement therapy in primary (thyroidal), secondary (pituitary), and tertiary (hypothalamic) congenital or acquired hypothyroidism
note: Primary hypothyroidism is named directly.

quote: Severe essential hypertension when the drug cannot be given orally or when there is an urgent need to lower blood pressure
note: Malignant essential hypertension is a subtype of the indicated (severe) essential hypertension.
Lumateperone is indicated for schizophrenia, bipolar depression and MDD; perinatal asphyxia is not mentioned.

quote: with cisplatin for unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic untreated NSCLC
note: Stage IIIB NSCLC falls under locally advanced NSCLC, so it is a subtype of the indication.

quote: indicated for the treatment of adult patients with H. pylori infection and duodenal ulcer disease
note: The only infection indicated is H. pylori; the generic class "Infection" is far too broad.
Loratadine relieves allergy symptoms such as itching of the nose or throat; throat pain is not mentioned.

quote: indicated for the management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic and for which alternative treatments are inadequate
note: Breast pain is a narrower subtype of the generic pain indication; the granularity rule favours TARGET.

quote: indicated for the treatment of severe hepatic veno-occlusive disease (VOD) also known as sinusoidal obstructive syndrome (SOS)
note: Hepatic VOD is named directly.

quote: indicated for the management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic and for which alternative treatments are inadequate
note: Infusion site pain is a narrower subtype of the generic pain indication; the granularity rule favours TARGET.

quote: Treatment and prophylaxis of bleeding in patients with haemophilia A (congenital factor VIII deficiency)
note: Haemophilia A is named as the indicated condition, with its bleeding managed.

quote: Laboratory studies should be done to ascertain that the lipid levels are consistently abnormal before instituting therapy
note: "Lipid measurement" is a lab test used as a prerequisite; the indication is severe hypertriglyceridemia.

quote: reduction of elevated intraocular pressure in patients with open angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension
note: Ocular hypertension is named directly.
Ranitidine indications are ulcers, GERD and hypersecretory states; back pain is not mentioned.

quote: indicated for up to 8 weeks for the treatment of active duodenal ulcer
note: Duodenal ulcer is named directly.

quote: indicated for the management of moderate to severe pain associated with endometriosis
note: Managing the pain of endometriosis counts as managing the disease under the rubric.

quote: Reduce the risk of acute urinary retention
note: Prevention of acute urinary retention in BPH is an explicit indication goal.

quote: reducing the frequency and severity of serious infections associated with Chronic Granulomatous Disease (CGD)
note: Managing the defining infections of CGD counts as disease management, as with bleeding in haemophilia.
The acetaminophen indications supplied are pain only; sneezing is not mentioned.

quote: for the treatment of adult patients with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal carcinoma
note: Stage III ovarian cancer is a narrower form of the indicated ovarian carcinoma.

quote: Primary or secondary adrenocortical insufficiency
note: Secondary adrenal insufficiency is named directly.

quote: Respiratory tract infections caused by Mycoplasma pneumoniae
note: Respiratory tract infections are listed indications.

quote: useful in combination with other oncolytic agents in Hodgkin's disease, non–Hodgkin's malignant lymphomas, rhabdomyosarcoma, neuroblastoma, and Wilms' tumor
note: Neuroblastoma is named in the indication list.

quote: indicated for the treatment of hypertension, alone or with other antihypertensive agents, to lower blood pressure
note: Hypertension secondary to endocrine disorders is a subtype of the indicated hypertension.

quote: indicated for the treatment of tinea cruris and tinea corporis
note: Tinea cruris is dermatophytosis of the groin.

quote: indicated for the treatment of patients with moderate to severe depression associated with moderate to severe anxiety
note: The chlordiazepoxide/amitriptyline combination is indicated for depression.

quote: indicated for the prevention or amelioration of symptoms associated with acute mountain sickness
note: Prevention of acute mountain sickness is an explicit indication.

quote: Ibuprofen Tablets are indicated for relief of mild to moderate pain.
note: Bladder pain is a narrower subtype of the generic pain indication; the granularity rule favours TARGET.

quote: indicated for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) in adults who have a mutation in the superoxide dismutase 1 ( SOD1 ) gene
note: ALS is named directly.

quote: Urinary Tract Infections caused by sensitive strains of E. coli and Proteus mirabilis
note: Recurrent UTI is a subtype of the indicated urinary tract infections.
